summary: Backend-only verification of Iteration 14 fix: global @app.exception_handler(InvalidId) catches bson.errors.InvalidId anywhere in the stack and returns HTTP 400 with Arabic detail 'معرّف غير صالح' instead of the previous 500. Verified via 7 new tests covering all invalid-ObjectId scenarios requested in the review: GET /api/customers/invalid-id, GET /api/generators/invalid-id, GET /api/invoices/invalid-id, GET /api/readings/invalid-id, DELETE /api/customers/invalid-id, PUT /api/customers/invalid-id, and multiple malformed shapes (invalid-id, not-a-hex, 12345, zzzz..). All return 400 with the exact Arabic detail. Regression: well-formed but non-existent ObjectId (507f1f77bcf86cd799439011) still correctly returns 404 (not swallowed by the InvalidId handler). All previous regression tests still pass. Result: 71/71 PASSED (100%). Previous iteration_13 flag (safe_object_id defined-but-unused) is now effectively resolved by the global handler approach - cleaner than mechanically replacing every ObjectId() call-site.

minor.issue: safe_object_id() helper is still defined but never called - now redundant given the global exception handler. Consider removing to reduce dead code, or use it inline for explicit 400 responses when you also need to short-circuit before I/O.
(carried) status query param not whitelisted; N update_one calls per read to flip is_overdue - prefer a single update_many.
(carried) No amount>0 validation; expense_type still free-form string (no Enum).
allow_origins=['*'] is safe with allow_credentials=False, but a per-env allowlist is recommended for production.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L821-826: @app.exception_handler(InvalidId) correctly registered on the FastAPI app (not APIRouter) and returns JSONResponse(status_code=400, content={'detail':'معرّف غير صالح'}). Verified across GET/PUT/DELETE for customers/generators/invoices/readings.

The handler approach is cleaner than replacing every ObjectId(id) call: single source of truth, and it also catches InvalidId raised transitively (e.g., inside cascade deletes, joins, or aggregation stages).
Verified 404 semantics preserved: well-formed ObjectId that doesn't match a document still returns 404 (not caught by InvalidId handler because bson successfully parses the id).

rca_of_issue: Not applicable - fix verified working. Root of the previous 500 was that route handlers called ObjectId(path_param) directly; bson raised InvalidId which propagated as an unhandled exception -> FastAPI default 500. Iteration 14 registered a global exception handler mapping InvalidId -> 400, which requires zero changes to the route handlers themselves.
